name: file-tree
title: File Tree
blurb: Expandable folder/file hierarchy with keyboard navigation and selection.
description: Tree view component displaying a recursive file structure. Folders toggle open/closed via accordion; files show only when parent is expanded. Supports click-to-select, keyboard navigation with arrow keys, and custom folder/file icons…
use_when: File explorers, documentation navigation trees, or project hierarchies where users browse and select items.
avoid_when: Very deep trees (>15 levels) where navigation becomes cumbersome or when keyboard shortcuts conflict with the app.
a11y: Folders and files are accordion buttons with full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter). Selected item indicated via context. No roving tabindex; focus must be managed by parent.
